AIセーフティ・インスティテュート（AISI）
implementation_notes: This is Japan's first AI Basic Plan (人工知能基本計画), adopted by Cabinet decision on 23 December 2025 under Article 18(1) of the AI Act (令和7年法律第53号). It is a government strategy document, not binding legislation. Key pillars: (1) accelerating AI utilization, (2) strengthening AI development capacity, (3) leading AI governance, (4) continuous societal transformation. AISI to be doubled in staffing immediately. No explicit prohibited practices stated; focus is on innovation promotion balanced with risk response. No formal compliance deadlines specified.
